name: deck_export
description: Export a projection: `spine`, or `pdf` written to `out` (each slide at its last state, or `states`, one page each). Frames and video (PLAN 1.21) and HTML (2.5) say which task builds them.

bundle.description: The bundle: a directory, a `.scaena` zip, or a `deck.json`.

format.description:
`spine` or `pdf`; `png`, `svg`, `mp4`, `webm`, and `html` name the PLAN tasks that
build them.

states.description: The states a frame export draws; every state without it.

out.description: Also write the export here; a PDF is written only here.

pages.description: The state each page draws, in order, for `pdf`.

bytes.description: The document's size in bytes, for `pdf`.
